title: Minecraft 26.3 on Cookie Build
summary: Cookie Build now runs Minecraft Java 26.3, with updated connection support for Java and Bedrock players.
body:
- Updated the server to Paper 26.3 build 238.
- Updated Bedrock connectivity to Geyser 2.12.1 build 1284.
- Updated support for different Java client versions with ViaVersion and ViaBackwards 5.12.2, including fixes for block-breaking effects and blocks displayed by older clients.
